P069.authors: Z Li, L Xu, W Wang, J Zhang, J Wang, B Peng, Z Zeng

complete_examples.text: The train-track-subgrade interaction is established as the model fundament, and the empirical model of soil cumulative deformation prediction is introduced to realize the joint analysis of the train-induced cumulative deformation of the subgrade and its effect on the performance of the time-varying dynamic system.
Although some scholars [20,21] employed the constitutive model to predict the CDS, their models make certain simpli-fications and the effect may not be as good as the empirical model.
